statements.t: We remain on track to begin realizing benefits from One Tredegar in the first quarter of 2027, and our focus now is execution: improving profitability, generating cash and investing behind the opportunities that can create long-term shareholder value.”

Through the remainder of 2026, we have successfully secured nearly all of Bonnell Aluminum’s anticipated aluminum supply requirements and are proactively reviewing Bonnell Aluminum’s 2027 supply needs and sources to minimize exposure to the Middle East.

These strategic shifts in our supply chain and internal capabilities are intended to strengthen our operational resilience, positioning Bonnell Aluminum to be a provider of innovative, custom-engineered aluminum solutions.
The Company does not expect significant expenses from business development activities in 2026.
